lines.text: Carry as much water, free of cost, as he/she liked, on the day appointed for Hazrat
Usman :. The Muslims as well as the Jews made full use of Hazrat Usman's t?
generosity and carried enough water to last for the next day as well.
The Jew learnt a bitter lesson. Whereas he had hoped to make more money, he
made none at all. He went to Hazrat Usman  and offered to sell the other half
of the well also. Hazrat Usman  could have refused to buy it, for the Muslims
had no longer any difficulty, but such was his generosity that he paid the Jew
whatever he asked for his share. The well was dedicated as an endowment to the
people of Madina. The well exists in Medina to this day and is known as Baire
